audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly calls the save/anti-pick ability 'W Devour' (whys[3], whys[4], spikes[1], mid, late, wants.you[0], wants.foe[1]), but per the kit Devour is R and W is Abyssal Dive (the knock-up dive engage).
audit.why: Kit data: W = Abyssal Dive (dive + knockup), R = Devour (swallow ally to shield / enemy to damage-and-remove). Naming Devour as W misidentifies which ability to track and which cooldown matters for the anti-pick save.
audit.corrected: All 'W Devour' references corrected to 'R Devour'; W-related save language corrected to R.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side all read 'Skill' while content.win[0..6] all read 'Tahm Kench' — the two layers disagree on every row.
audit.why: Content's whys already ground a Tahm Kench-favoured matchup at every stage (Q slow + grey-health shield early, R Devour anti-pick from 6 on, unexecutable bulk late), matching the 51.38% enemy-leaning packet win rate and full-layer TRICKY/7-10 difficulty rating. The full-layer chart rows were simply never updated off the generic 'Skill' placeholder.
audit.corrected: All 7 phases[N].side -> 'Tahm Kench' with matching whys rewritten to the kit-grounded reasons.

audit.why: Power spikes correctly keyed once the W/R naming is fixed: level 2 Q-slow/E-shield trade loss, level 6 R Devour neutering your R execute, first-item bulk tanking your burst, late unexecutable frontline.

edits.before: Your R execute is neutered because Tahm W Devour swallows his own ADC out of your all-in, then eats himself or walks away tanky; never commit R expecting a clean kill here.
edits.after: Your R execute is neutered because Tahm's R Devour swallows his own ADC out of your all-in, or eats himself and walks away tanky; never commit R expecting a clean kill here.

edits.before: From 3 to 6 Tahm keeps the advantage. His W Devour is the ultimate anti-pick tool: the moment you hook his ADC, he swallows them out of your kill window, and at 6 your R can't execute a target that just vanished into a whale. He's too beefy for your lethality burst, and his Q stun turns any greedy dive against you. Roam to influence lanes Tahm can't defend, since his lane presence hard-counters your bot-lane picks.
edits.after: From 3 to 6 Tahm keeps the advantage. His R Devour is the ultimate anti-pick tool: the moment you hook his ADC, he swallows them out of your kill window, and your own R can't execute a target that just vanished into a whale. He's too beefy for your lethality burst, and his Q stun turns any greedy dive against you. Roam to influence lanes Tahm can't defend, since his lane presence hard-counters your bot-lane picks.

edits.before: Late game Tahm fully answers your identity. He W-saves whatever you hook, shrugs off your R with grey health and raw tankiness, and peels your dives with Q slows and stuns. You cannot out-fight or execute him, so your only value is catching his backline before he can react with Devour, ideally with your team collapsing. Solo, you lose every exchange into a fed Tahm. Play vision and flanks and pick targets outside his save range.
